name: pull-request
description: Creates, updates, or reviews a GitHub pull request from the current branch with a validated, traceable body.

interface.shortDescription: Open, update, or validate a pull request
interface.longDescription: Create or update a GitHub pull request from the current branch. The skill analyzes the full diff against the base branch, finds the related issue, validates the repository state, checks for secrets and risky changes, runs the project's validation commands, drafts a structured body, validates it, and submits it with the GitHub CLI. It never merges, force-pushes, or bypasses failed checks.
defaultPrompt: Open a pull request for the current branch
Update the title and body of this pull request
Validate a pull request body before submitting it
